rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for bothering or irritating someone, especially repeatedly.

example.english: You keep calling me, and it does annoy me.
example.jyutping: nei5 seng4 jat6 daa2 lei4 faan4 ngo5

rows.note: Use this when the annoying behavior makes someone angry or upset rather than merely bothered.

example.english: The way you keep messing with me really does annoy me.
example.traditional: 你咁樣玩我，真係搞到我好嬲。
example.jyutping: nei5 gam3 joeng6 waan2 ngo5 zan1 hai6 gaau2 dou3 ngo5 hou2 nau1
